svg.title: Mo62A workload temperature observations — October 22, 2026
svg.desc: One trace per workload, maximum of three recorded thermal zones at each sample. Elapsed time resets for every run. Runs end at their final samples, without smoothing or extrapolation. Not ambient temperature or thermal equilibrium.
